# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.tagline }} — {{ site.description }}

Software Engineer at Adobe (since 2017, starting at Marketo) transitioning from site reliability, Kubernetes infrastructure, observability, and agentic systems into **ML Inference Engineering** and **GPU Kernel Engineering**.

## Focus & Target Roles

- **Target roles:** ML Inference Engineer, GPU Systems Engineer, ML Infrastructure Engineer (LLM serving, performance benchmarking, reliability).
- **Current focus:** Triton & CUDA GPU kernels (Vizuara AI Kernel Engineering), building LLMs from scratch in PyTorch (Sebastian Raschka), and LLM serving/benchmarking with vLLM and SGLang (p50/p99 latency, TTFT, tokens/s, MFU, KV-cache management).

## Background & Skills

- **Languages:** Python, Java
- **ML & LLMs:** PyTorch, Transformers, LLM evaluation (*analyze → measure → improve*, Hamel Husain & Shreya Shankar), agentic frameworks (LangGraph), agent harnesses & isolated sandboxes (Agent Sandbox), A2A protocol
- **Inference & Kernels (in progress):** Triton, CUDA, vLLM, SGLang, roofline/MFU analysis
- **Infrastructure:** Kubernetes (CKA), Argo (Argo CD, Argo Workflows, Argo Rollouts — Rolling Update, Canary, Blue-Green), Docker, Helm, Terraform, Airflow, FastAPI, microservices, GitOps CI/CD
- **Observability:** Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Splunk
- **Data:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server, Azure Data Explorer, Redis, Databricks
- **Education:** Master of Information Systems Management, Carnegie Mellon University (Heinz College, 2017); B.Tech in Information Technology, SRM University (2013)
- **Certifications:** Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA, Linux Foundation, 2024); AI Evals for Engineers & PMs (Maven, 2026); Udacity Nanodegrees in Cloud DevOps (2020), Data Engineering (2020), and Machine Learning (2019)

## Key Repositories

- [pytorch_tutorials](https://github.com/karthikBalasubramanian/pytorch_tutorials): Building an LLM from scratch in PyTorch (BPE tokenization, embeddings, causal/multi-head attention, GPTModel, MPS vs CPU benchmarks, DDP)
- [jev-tutorials](https://github.com/karthikBalasubramanian/jev-tutorials): Calibrated non-generative decision models for support triage in TypeScript/Node.js (Vercel AI SDK)
- [project-ml-microservice-kubernetes](https://github.com/karthikBalasubramanian/project-ml-microservice-kubernetes): Containerized ML inference API deployed on Kubernetes with CI/CD and structured logging
- [FER](https://github.com/karthikBalasubramanian/FER): Facial emotion recognition using heuristic and transfer learning
